criteria.reason: Openly retracts the 2% claim and supplies the correct +0.2% (2025 average) and +0.1% (December 2025) figures.
Cites official FSO data and up-to-date statistics, but never explains why the earlier 2% was wrong or why the release is stronger.
Dates figures to January 2026 releases, but does not note that more recent monthly data may exist.

summary: Openly corrects the 2% claim with accurate, dated FSO figures, but the explanation for accepting the correction is thin and newer data isn't flagged.
